Prop_sakura_schoolyard_CherryTree.notes: Changed after look: trunk thickened (r 1.0->1.25, root flare 1.8), third branch, lobes flattened 0.85->0.78 and overlapped so the crown reads as one mass, light-pink caps flattened. Key colour IS the crown.

Prop_pirate_harbor_PalmTree.notes: Changed after look: first build 10.13 wide (+12.5%), lean 2.4->1.2 and frond reach rebalanced; fronds widened. Orange key = rope band at trunk base (small; reads at mid range only).

Prop_sakura_schoolyard_SchoolGate.notes: Changed after look: spindly gate with diagonal brace (read as a broken ladder) replaced by a framed panel: thicker bars, mid rail, end stiles. Plate glyphs are slate blocks (no text).

Prop_sakura_schoolyard_ClockTower.notes: Defect fixed: first build 17.8 wide because Euler XYZ yaws before pitching, so side clock discs faced Z and stuck out; discs now pre-rotated. Tris 4166->3954 (ring segments 16->12). Roof raised 4.2->6.6 after look (read as a flat lid). Clock on all four sides. Height now 38.0 (+12%, inside the 15% allowance) because of the taller roof.

Prop_pirate_harbor_PirateShip.notes: Bow at -Z. Flat keel at y=0 (sits on a water plane, not in it). Hull and deck are both wood browns; the orange stripe and gunwale carry the contrast.

Prop_ninja_village_WatchPost.notes: Defect fixed: Kiln rejected the program with no message; error was Manifold 'Not manifold' from four equal-length balcony rails whose corner faces coincided. Rails now differ in length; prelude falls back to incremental union. Depth +12% is the front ladder.

Prop_pirate_harbor_Lighthouse.notes: Red #F04848 is not in the bible palette (brief asked red and white).

Prop_sakura_schoolyard_TrackHurdle.notes: Red blocks stand 0.05 proud of the white board (no coplanar faces). Red #F04848 not in bible palette. No change after look.

Prop_pirate_harbor_Dock.notes: Deck top at y 2.45, posts to 3.0. Plank gaps 0.15 show dark stringers. Life ring on the -X outside of the front post is small. No change after look.

Prop_pirate_harbor_BarrelStack.notes: Orange hoops on all three barrels + orange stripe on crate front. No change after look.

Prop_ninja_village_BambooCluster.notes: Changed after look: 4420 tris (over 4000 budget) -> node rings as plain 4-point bands, wider node spacing, one side tuft -> 3748. Leaves are the key green; stalks #5BD43A, so the greens are close in hue.

Prop_ninja_village_RopeBridge.notes: Changed after look: 4204 tris -> rope tubes 6-sided, 5 hangers per side -> 3092. Deck sags 1.9 -> 1.05 at mid-span. Rope tubes are 0.44-0.48 thick (above the 0.4 floor).

Prop_ninja_village_HiddenGate.notes: Swirl is an ink tube (0.44 thick) on a light plaque in a green frame. No change after look.

Prop_ninja_village_TrainingLog.notes: Changed after look: 3.485 wide (+16%) because the throwing stars stuck out; stars smaller and deeper -> 3.086. Weak point: the stars read as dark wedges, not clearly as shuriken; star tips are thinner than 0.4 in-plane (0.4 thick).
